resources.string: Choose a folder in the system picker. No video copy starts there.
Folder selected. Confirm below to retain its exact grant and copy the frozen selection. This does not change your default save folder. System folder permissions may remain after cancellation.
Confirm folder and copy selected videos
Copying items separately to the admitted folder. Originals remain; this is not an atomic batch.
Batch attempts ended. Inspect each result below; unverified or uncertain copies are not confirmed complete.
Batch stopped. Unstarted items are not copied; completed copies remain. System folder grants are not automatically revoked.
Selection expired. No new batch is admitted; choose the videos and folder again.
Folder picker unavailable or grant not accepted. No default directory is substituted.
Folder admission or copy results are unconfirmed. Originals remain. Check only this operation’s owned copies; do not infer rollback.
A previous folder batch is stopped. Unstarted items will not automatically resume. Earlier outputs, including interrupted copies, may need verification; a new explicit batch creates new copies.
